summary: Clearwater National Forest lookout: an L-4 cab on a log crib, built in 1934 and abandoned by 1945. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1945 and listed as gone; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: FFLA Idaho list types Hungry Point as a 2-Story cab

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three sources (firelookout.com, the Forest Service list and Idaho Fire Lookouts) agree on the 1934 build and 1945 abandonment. The Forest Lookouts Idaho County list and the FFLA entry give no build or abandonment date, and none of the sources describes the site today or gives a height. FFLA lists the kind as 2-Story cab; the sources describe an L-4 cab on a log crib without a story count, so two_story is unconfirmed. No staffing is documented (Idaho Fire Lookouts says so). No new photos found.
